name: Password Changed
description: Confirms that the authenticated user's password was changed successfully and provides a single action to leave the completion surface.

web.notes: Canonical completion surface discovered during Password Management scenario reconciliation.

mobile.notes: Web and mobile should expose the same semantic confirmation and Done action.

notes: The destination of action:done is intentionally deferred to presentation reconciliation.
This view exists because a successful password change has a materially distinct terminal presentation from a rejected password change.
